records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net product sales were $114,560 in second quarter 2021 compared to $79,796 in second quarter 2020, an increase of $34,764 or 43.6%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: First half 2021 net product sales were $216,355 compared to $182,599 in first half 2020, an increase of $33,756 or 18.5%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: First half 2021 cash flows from operating activities principally benefited from higher net earnings, lower finished goods inventories at June 30, 2021 reflecting higher than planned demand, the timing of production of finished goods, and changes in accounts payable and accrued liabilities in the comparative periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product cost of goods sold were $75,948 in second quarter 2021 compared to $50,379 in second quarter 2020, and first half 2021 product cost of goods sold were $141,513 compared to $116,822 in first half 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjusting for these deferred compensation costs and expenses, adjusted earnings from operations were $12,375 and $9,911 in second quarter 2021 and 2020, respectively, an increase of $2,464 or 24.9%; and adjusted operating earnings were $25,974 and $21,280 in first half 2021 and 2020, respectively, an increase of $4,694 or 22.1%.
